jobs.title: Audio Visual Technician – Audio Engineer
jobs.description:
**Where Ambition Meets Innovation**

Build a career that matches all your initiative with an impressive dose of innovation. From cutting-edge resources and a collaborative environment to the freedom to make an impact and more, you’ll find the ingredients you need at LPL Financial to shape your success while helping clients pursue their financial goals.

**Job Overview**
----------------

LPL Financial is seeking an **Audio Visual Technician – Audio Engineer** with a strong background in audio engineering and live production to support corporate meetings, executive presentations, town halls, livestreams, and special events.

This role will primarily focus on professional audio production, including live sound mixing, microphone systems, audio signal routing, recording, system configuration, and troubleshooting. The position will also provide general AV and event support, including equipment setup and strike.

The ideal candidate is technically skilled, dependable, customer-focused, and comfortable working in a fast-paced corporate environment supporting high-visibility events.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

Audio Production & Engineering

* Set up, operate, and troubleshoot professional audio systems for corporate meetings, executive events, town halls, livestreams, and live productions.
* Operate digital audio consoles, wireless microphone systems, playback devices, processors, and related professional audio equipment.
* Mix live audio for in-room audiences, broadcasts, livestreams, recordings, and virtual participants.
* Manage audio signal flow, routing, gain structure, EQ, dynamics processing, and overall system levels.
* Set up and manage wireless lavalier, handheld, podium, and other microphone systems.
* Perform sound checks and ensure clear, consistent audio throughout live events.
* Monitor RF and wireless microphone performance and quickly identify and resolve interference or connectivity issues.
* Troubleshoot audio issues including feedback, distortion, signal loss, routing problems, and equipment failures.
* Support audio integration with video conferencing, livestreaming, recording, and broadcast systems.
* Record event audio and assist with media management and archiving as needed.

General AV & Event Support

* Set up, operate, and strike AV equipment for meetings, conferences, and corporate events.
* Provide general support for video systems, displays, projectors, lighting, presentation systems, and video conferencing.
* Set up and strike pipe and drape, staging, and other event production equipment as needed.
* Run, secure, and manage AV cabling while maintaining safe, clean, and professional event spaces.
* Assist with equipment testing, maintenance, inventory, and organization.
* Participate in rehearsals, pre-production meetings, event setup, and post-event breakdown.
* Partner with presenters, executives, producers, event teams, and other AV professionals to deliver a high-quality event experience.

Primary Areas of Responsibility

Audio Engineering | Live Sound | Corporate Events | Livestreaming | Broadcast Audio | General AV Support

**What are we looking for?**
----------------------------

We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates **pursue greatness**, **act with integrity**, and are **driven to help our clients succeed**. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we **win together** and **create and share joy** in our work.

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* **Live Video Production & Multi-Camera Operation:** minimum of 3 years supporting live corporate events, broadcasts, town halls, or livestreams with hands-on operation of professional cameras, PTZ cameras, and multi-camera production environments.
* **Video Engineering & Signal Flow:** proven experience configuring and troubleshooting video signal routing, switching, distribution, resolutions, and frame rates with strong knowledge of SDI, HDMI, and NDI technologies.
* **Livestreaming & Recording:** experience supporting livestreams, virtual events, encoding, recording, and content distribution and ability to monitor and troubleshoot live productions in real time.
* **Video Switching & Production Equipment:** hands-on experience operating video switchers, routers, recording systems, monitors, and production control equipment.
* **Video Editing & Post-Production:** experience editing recorded content using Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, or similar platforms and ability to create polished internal communications, executive videos, and event recordings.

**Core Competencies:**
----------------------

* Professional video production and video engineering
* Multi-camera production
* Livestreaming and virtual event support
* Video signal routing and troubleshooting
* Camera setup, framing, focus, exposure, and color matching
* Presentation playback and confidence monitors
* Recording and media management
* Video quality control during live events
* Microsoft Teams, Zoom, and Webex support
* Audio, display, projector, and lighting support
* General AV event setup and breakdown
* Cable management and event safety
* Equipment testing, maintenance, inventory, and organization
* Technical troubleshooting and problem-solving
* Customer service and executive support
* Ability to perform under pressure during live events
* Team collaboration and event coordination

**Preferences:**
----------------

* Experience supporting executive-level meetings and town halls
* Corporate studio or broadcast production experience
* Advanced livestreaming workflows
* Advanced multi-camera production experience
* Strong post-production and video editing background
* Experience with vMix, OBS, Wirecast, or similar production platforms
* Knowledge of network-based AV/video technology

**Pay Range:**

$34.47-$57.44/hour

jobs.title: SoC Audio Engineer, Platform Architecture
jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
Do you love crafting elegant solutions to the hardest problems in audio and acoustics? Are you a big-picture, forward-thinking engineer who understands how audio subsystems integrate into a SoC and a system? At Apple, our Architecture group is responsible for connecting the hardware and software that bring sound to life across our products. Join this team, and you'll collaborate with engineers across Apple to design how our audio technologies work in unison!
  
  
Description
  
  
We are looking for a SoC Audio Architect to join our team defining the audio subsystem architecture for Apple's SoCs — technology that powers experiences across nearly every Apple product, from ultra-low-power keyword detection to high-fidelity spatial audio. This is primarily an audio subsystem architecture role, not an audio IP design role; experience designing audio IP is valued as background but is not the core function of the position. In this highly visible role, you will own the multi-generational subsystem architecture and roadmap for audio subsystems, collaborating closely with Silicon Engineering, Software Engineering, and Hardware Engineering teams to size subsystems and optimize trade-offs between performance, power, and area. You will have visibility across every product line and be accountable for architectures that scale across the portfolio, from early concept through tape-out and into shipping product.
  
  
Minimum Qualifications  
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree
* Experience with SoC architecture principles
* Experience with SoC audio processing

  
  
  
Preferred Qualifications  
  
  

* Master's degree with 10+ years of relevant industry experience
* Experience defining architecture specifications for audio, DSP, or signal processing subsystems within an SoC
* In-depth understanding of SoC architecture concepts, such as on-chip fabric protocols, memory concepts, and clocking, reset, and power management
* Skilled in digital signal processing algorithms, including audio algorithms
* Understanding of SoC power modeling and Power/Performance/Area (PPA) optimization
* Understanding of SoC audio interfaces (e.g., I2S, PDM, TDM, MIPI SWI3S)
* Proficiency in hardware/software co-design, including familiarity with RTL design concepts (e.g., System Verilog)
* Excellent interpersonal, leadership, and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence across organizations.

  
  
  
At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $175,000 and $263,300, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.  
  
Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple’s discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple’s Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You’ll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses — including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits  
  
Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.  
  
  

Apple is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. We seek to promote equal opportunity for all applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or other legally protected characteristics. Learn more about your EEO rights as an applicant

  
  
  

At Apple, we believe accessibility is a fundamental human right. You’ll find that idea reflected in everything here — in our culture, our benefits and our digital tools. By welcoming as many perspectives as possible, we help you build a career where you feel like you belong.  
  
Learn about accessibility in Apple’s workplace  
  
Learn about reasonable accommodations for job applicants

  
  
  

Apple accepts applications to this posting on an ongoing basis.

jobs.title: Lead Sound Designer
jobs.description: To create revolutionary, story-driven RPGs which go straight to the hearts of gamers — this is our mission. Want to dive deeper into our company’s culture? Explore our social media and check out our YouTube channel and Beyond the Game Blog where we share behind-the-scenes insights and stories direct from our team members! CD PROJEKT RED is looking for an experienced Lead Sound Designer to join our studio in Warsaw to drive audio development of Witcher 4. As a Lead Sound Designer, you will be responsible for leading the Sound Design team and collaborating with cross-discipline teams to create and deliver an immersive audio experience for our upcoming game. If you are an accomplished game audio artist and experienced leader with a passion for crafting soundscapes for widely respected, narrative-driven RPGs, we want to hear from you! Daily Responsibilities: Lead a team of Sound Designers and drive game audio development in the project. Help define and maintain aesthetic continuity throughout the game and trailers, in alignment with previous releases in the IP where appropriate. Collaborate closely with project Directors, Leads, Producers, and cross-discipline teams (Music, VO, Programmers) to craft immersive, high-quality, and technologically advanced audio experiences. Plan, revise, track, and execute milestones, sprints, and roadmap deliverables. Support and coach team members to achieve impactful and high-quality in-game results while fostering their growth and development. Support the design and development of innovative audio systems using Unreal Engine 5, Wwise middleware, and in-house tools. Design, implement, and mix original and rich sound effects. 7+ years of professional experience in the video game industry, with involvement in multiple shipped AAA titles. At least 2 years of experience in a leadership role related to sound design or audio direction. Strong creative skills and a focus on quality, evidenced by a portfolio, demo reel, or game credits. Collaborative approach to navigating challenges and resolving design obstacles. Exceptional artistic and creative competence. Effective cross-disciplinary communication skills. Ability to manage timelines and coordinate with teams. Skilled communicator experienced in collaborating across development teams and providing supportive leadership to direct reports. Nice to Have: (These skills are not required to apply for the position) Experience with Atmos, Surround Sound, 3D Audio, and HRTF. Experience working with performance capture. Experience planning and executing field and Foley recording sessions. Working mode In-office in a hybrid or full-time capacity in Warsaw, Poland. Relocation is required. Relocation Support Relocation package — flight ticket, company apartment for your first month, relocating your pet and family, shipping your belongings. It’s all covered. Relocation assistance — processing your legalization operations for you and  tax settlements — all you need to feel right at home is taken care of. Polish lessons for foreign employees — and for your spouse or partner, too. Paid Leave — from 20 to 26 days of holiday per year, and paid sick leave. Health & Well-Being Private medical healthcare — a selection of medical plans with dental care and unlimited rehabilitation to choose from, which are also accessible for your partner and relatives. Life insurance — comprehensive pension and insurance plans to protect you and your loved ones. Annual screenings for cancer prevention covered by the company. Psychological and psychiatrist care — free mental health support and various well-being initiatives. Sports card — gain access to a wide number of sporting and fitness facilities across the city. Menstrual leave — employees who menstruate can take one extra day off when experiencing period pain. RED Parents Network — support for working parents, including childcare benefits, and family-friendly events. RED Summer Camp for Kids — a fun summer program for children aged 5–12, majoritively paid by the company. Perks & Professional Growth A welcome pack filled with goodies — to help you feel right at home once you join the team. Trainings, lectures, and courses — workshops and trainings for each employee, knowledge-sharing initiatives, online tutorials, and e-learning classes are all available. There’s always something to learn! REDs have access to the cafeteria platform through which they can receive subscription benefits, additional medical packages or vouchers and codes to shops, cinemas, and public transport reimbursement. Gifts for newborn rebels and regular chances to nab some cool swag! Social Activities & Life in the Office Dog-friendly office — dog owner? Bring your pooch with you and look after them while working! There’s always a furry friend or two to meet at the studio. Social events — we host regular gatherings at the studio where we can all unwind, play games, and just have some fun together. Healthy selections — ​​canteens. Truly international working environment — a chance to meet and work with a diverse selection of people from all around the world. Sustainability is an ongoing commitment for us, and our campus has  electric car charging points, green zones, and much more. Read all about it on our Beyond the Game Blog . A designated space for your bicycle, as well as bicycle repair equipment and showers available whenever you need them. An onsite, well-equipped gym with a climbing wall, daily Gym Assistant support, and yoga and boxing classes. No dress-code — we like to keep it casual. Estimated pay range for this position: 31 800 – 43 725 PLN gross monthly. This role may be eligible for a long term incentive program (option to purchase CDPR stock after the vesting period). Final offers are dependent on job-related factors like experience and qualifications. Type of contract: Employment Contract ("Umowa o pracę"). If you've observed any irregularities (i.e. legal or ethical violations) in our recruitment process, please click here to report them anonymously. #LI-Hybrid

Open Roles Role Detail General Information Locations : Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada Role ID 216383 Worker Type Temporary Employee Studio/Department EA Studios - SPORTS Work Model Hybrid Description & Requirements Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen. Audio Artist II – Speech Production EA SPORTS™ NHL Who We Are EA SPORTS is one of the most iconic brands in entertainment – connecting hundreds of millions around the world to the sports they love through a portfolio of industry-leading video games. EA SPORTS NHL has revolutionised sports gaming for millions of players worldwide. We've pioneered award-winning creative technology and experiences to connect players to the speed, skill, and heart of the NHL. Role Overview We are looking for an Audio Artist II to join the EA SPORTS NHL Audio team. The primary focus of this role is mastering, organising, and delivering high-quality recorded speech for commentary, voice-over, and other in-game experiences. You will also support speech-production workflows using AI tools that help the team maintain content at scale. Reporting to the Audio Lead, you will work independently within a defined area, applying editorial judgement and technical discipline to ensure assets meet creative, pipeline, and in-game quality standards. The Challenge Ahead Your challenge will be to turn recorded and generated source material into game-ready assets while maintaining accuracy across naming, metadata, versioning, and delivery. You will review content critically and work with speech leads, audio leadership, production, and technical partners to resolve issues. You will contribute ideas within your area, help improve established workflows, estimate your work with guidance, and communicate status, dependencies, and risks early. Who You Are You are an audio professional with dialogue-editing and mastering skills. You are comfortable working through high volumes of content without losing consistency, and you understand how editorial choices affect clarity, authenticity, and the player experience. You evaluate and integrate new tools through active testing and structured analysis. You will review audio outputs to identify artifacts and inconsistencies, correct manageable issues through direct editing, and escalate complex problems to the speech team. You will maintain structured asset workflows, integrate team reviews into your daily process, and implement solutions to increase our audio processing pipeline's reliability. Responsibilities Master, clean, and quality-check commentary, dialogue, and other speech assets. Use approved speech-generation and processing tools to create or adapt content, then evaluate and prepare outputs to team standards. Identify issues involving noise, level, dynamics, spectral balance, timing, pronunciation, continuity, or processing artifacts. Maintain accurate naming, metadata, versioning, source files, and delivery structures. Prepare, import, and validate speech assets in game-audio tools, databases, and established pipelines. Track assigned work, provide estimates with lead support, and communicate priorities, dependencies, and schedule risks. Participate in troubleshooting and recommend practical improvements to tools and workflows. Document processes and share knowledge. Requirements Professional experience editing and mastering dialogue, commentary, VO, ADR, broadcast, or comparable speech content. Advanced proficiency with Pro Tools or another professional DAW, including dialogue cleanup, EQ, dynamics, noise reduction, loudness control, and batch workflows. Demonstrated experience evaluating audio to identify subtle quality, consistency, and processing errors. 3+ years of experience managing assets against technical specifications, naming conventions, metadata, and version-control requirements. Experience with game-audio authoring tools, databases, or content pipelines. You will document technical workflows, track project milestones, and coordinate asset deliveries across multiple technical and creative departments. Experience with modern speech-production, voice-processing, automation, or scripting workflows is an asset. Pay Transparency - North America COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS The ranges listed below are what EA in good faith expects to pay applicants for this role in these locations at the time of this posting. If you reside in a different location, a recruiter will advise on the applicable range and benefits. Pay offered will be determined based on a number of relevant business and candidate factors (e.g. education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, geographic location, or business needs). PAY RANGES * British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$67,000 - $92,700 CAD Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA. In Canada, we offer a package of benefits including vacation (3 weeks per year to start), 10 days per year of sick time, and extended health/dental/vision coverage and basic life insurance. About Electronic Arts We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth. We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do. Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Concepteur audio technique / Technical Audio Designer
jobs.description: En tant que concepteur audio technique, vous vous situez à l’intersection du design sonore et de l’ingénierie, transformant les éléments audio en systèmes en jeu performants et peaufinés. En collaboration avec les concepteurs sonores, les ingénieurs et les concepteurs techniques, vous intégrerez l’audio dans Unreal Engine et Wwise, concevrez des outils et optimiserez les performances. Il s’agit d’un rôle pratique destiné à une personne souhaitant évoluer à la jonction de la création et de la technique. Contrat de 12 mois Responsabilités: Intégrer les éléments audio dans Unreal Engine à l’aide du moteur sonore Wwise, de l’élément source jusqu’au système jouable. Concevoir et maintenir des systèmes audio basés sur les Blueprints. Développer et améliorer des outils permettant d’accélérer le flux de travail des concepteurs sonores. Profiler et optimiser l’audio en termes de CPU, mémoire, nombre de voix et flux (streaming) à l’aide du Wwise Profiler et d’Unreal Audio Insights. Respecter les directives d’organisation des données et de mixage de Wwise afin de garantir la cohérence du contenu et sa capacité à passer à l’échelle. Diagnostiquer et résoudre les problèmes audio en collaboration avec l’équipe de développement. Rédiger et maintenir la documentation technique des fonctionnalités, outils et flux de travail audio. Communiquer clairement les progrès et les contraintes techniques aux collaborateurs non techniques. Exigences: 3 ans ou plus d’expérience en audio technique, incluant un cycle de production complet jusqu’au lancement du jeu. Compétences démontrables en intégration audio avec Unreal Engine et Wwise. Solide maîtrise des Blueprints Unreal pour l’intégration audio. Maîtrise de Wwise. Connaissance pratique d’une station de travail audio numérique (DAW) telle que Reaper ou Pro Tools. Fortes capacités de résolution de problèmes et souci du détail. Capacité à apprendre rapidement de nouvelles technologies, outils et concepts. Bonnes aptitudes en communication et travail d’équipe, incluant la capacité d’expliquer des contraintes techniques à des collaborateurs non techniques. Intérêt réel pour l’audio technique appliqué au jeu vidéo, couplé à une bonne oreille. Atouts: Bonne compréhension de Wwise Spatial Audio. Connaissance pratique de l’API Wwise Authoring (WAAPI). Compétences en programmation d’scripts en Python ou C#. Connaissance de base du C++ et de son rôle dans Unreal Engine. Technical Audio Designer As a Technical Audio Designer, you sit between sound design and engineering, turning audio assets into polished, performant in-game systems. Working with audio designers, engineers, and technical designers, you will implement audio in Unreal Engine and Wwise, build tooling, and optimize for performance. This is a hands-on role for someone who wants to grow at the intersection of creative and technical craft. 12-month contract Responsibilities: Integrate audio assets into Unreal Engine using the Wwise sound engine, from source asset to playable system. Build and maintain Blueprint-based audio systems. Develop and improve tools that speed up the audio designers' workflow. Profile and optimize audio for CPU, memory, voice count, and streaming using the Wwise Profiler and Unreal Audio Insights. Uphold Wwise data organization and mixing guidelines so content stays consistent and scales across the project. Troubleshoot and resolve audio issues in collaboration with the development team. Write and maintain technical documentation for audio features, tools, and workflows. Communicate progress and technical constraints clearly to non-technical collaborators. Required: 3+ years of technical audio experience, including one full production cycle through ship. Demonstrable audio implementation skills with Unreal Engine and Wwise. Strong command of Unreal Blueprints for audio implementation. Proficient with Wwise. Working knowledge of a DAW such as Reaper or Pro Tools. Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Ability to quickly learn new technology, tools, and concepts. Good communication and teamwork abilities, including explaining technical constraints to non-technical collaborators. Genuine interest in technical audio for games, with a good ear. Nice to have: Good understanding of Wwise Spatial Audio. Working knowledge of the Wwise Authoring API (WAAPI). Scripting abilities in Python or C#. Surface level understanding of C++ and its role in Unreal Engine. Justification des exigences linguistiques NetEase s'engage à favoriser un environnement de travail francophone pour ses employés au Québec. Tous les efforts ont été faits pour éviter d'exiger une langue autre que le français pour ce poste. Cependant, la maîtrise de l'anglais est essentielle pour ce poste, car l'employé devra communiquer régulièrement avec des collègues et des parties prenantes situés à l'extérieur du Québec, où l'anglais est la principale langue de communication entre les bureaux. Language Requirement Justification NetEase is committed to supporting a French-speaking workenvironment for its employees in Quebec. Every effort has been made to avoidrequiring a language other than French for this position. However, proficiency in English is essential for thisrole because the employee will be required to communicate regularly with colleagues and stakeholders located outside Quebec, where English is theprimary language of communication between offices.

jobs.title: Lead Audio Engineer
jobs.description:
***A great experience starts with you!***
=========================================

Join our team to help create and develop the future of live entertainment and sports in Orange County!

Once you've had a chance to explore our current open positions, apply to the ones you feel best suit you, as an applicant, you can always see your application status in your profile.

**Mission:** To be a place where the everyday becomes extraordinary - and the potential is unlimited. Where every experience can change you

**Vision:** We are the gathering place of Orange County

**Values:** Be Safe | Do the Right Thing | Be Generous | Include Everyone | Make it Easy | Be Bold

**Job Title:**
--------------

Lead Audio Engineer

**Pay Details:**

The starting hourly rate range for this position is $45.50 to $52.50 per hour. The actual hourly rate offered will take internal value, peer equity, job-related factors, and other organizational considerations into account.

The Lead Audio Engineer provides technical leadership to a team of audio technicians in delivering exceptional audio experiences across Honda Center and related event spaces. This role supports Anaheim Ducks home games, special events, select concerts, restaurants, clubs, indoor and outdoor venues, live production shoots, and audio editing needs. The position is responsible for the operation, maintenance, staffing, inventory, and repair of interior and exterior audio systems, including arena intercom and communications systems.

**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with clients, event managers, vendors, and creative teams to define project objectives, budgets, technical requirements, and desired guest experience.
* Lead audio operations for live events ranging from a 17,000-seat arena to small meeting and hospitality spaces.
* Plan and manage audio projects, including staffing, equipment, schedules, system configuration, and quality-control procedures.
* Partner with Multimedia, Video, Lighting, and production teams to deliver integrated event and broadcast solutions.
* Lead, mentor, and develop audio technicians and junior engineers, fostering a collaborative, accountable, and growth-oriented team environment.
* Support video production teams with pre-production, live production, and post-production audio needs.
* Manage radio-frequency coordination and support reliable wireless audio operations.
* Identify and implement innovative audio strategies that enhance the guest experience, including within OCVIBE event spaces.
* Maintain current knowledge of audio-production technologies, workflows, standards, and industry trends.
* Manage audio equipment inventory and ensure equipment is properly maintained, tested, calibrated, documented, and ready for use.
* Establish and maintain quality standards for live audio, recorded content, communications, and other audio deliverables.
* Coordinate with event vendors and television broadcast trucks to ensure audio and communications requirements are met.
* Investigate, diagnose, and resolve operational issues, service concerns, and emergency repairs promptly and effectively.
* Monitor live audio mixes while simultaneously receiving and responding to production direction and cues.
* Manage multiple concurrent priorities effectively in a fast-paced live-event environment.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in live-event audio engineering, production, or a related field, preferably within an arena, entertainment venue, broadcast, or similarly complex production environment.
* Prior experience leading or providing technical direction to audio technicians or production teams is strongly preferred.
* Advanced knowledge of professional entertainment and live-event audio systems.
* Proficiency with Yamaha CL5 digital mixing consoles or comparable platforms.
* Proficiency with Dante, MADI, Q-SYS, and related audio-networking and signal-distribution technologies.
* Strong understanding of audio engineering best practices, including signal flow, system routing, gain structure, loudspeaker placement, and microphone selection and placement.
* Proficiency with Riedel communications systems; experience with Evertz routing systems is preferred.
* Understanding of emergency-notification and assistive-listening systems, including hard-of-hearing (HOH) announcement systems.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
* Strong organizational, problem-solving, and written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to follow direction, collaborate across disciplines, and maintain a professional, solutions-oriented approach in demanding live-event environments.
* Ability to work a flexible schedule that may include weekdays, weekends, holidays, split shifts, late nights, and overnight shifts.
* Ability to perform the essential physical functions of the role, with or without reasonable accommodation, including prolonged standing and walking; bending; reaching; working with arms raised; navigating concrete, uneven, and slippery surfaces; repeatedly lifting and carrying up to 50 pounds; climbing portable and fixed ladders; and occasionally working at heights above 10 feet.
* Ability to work in indoor and outdoor environments that may include temperature changes, inclement weather, bright lighting, loud noise, dust, and other conditions.
* Ability to remain current with emerging production technologies and learn new systems and workflows.
* Ability to install, configure, troubleshoot, and operate audio interfaces and signal.

**Knowledge, Skills and Experience**

**Education -** High School Diploma or Equivalent

**Experience Required -** 5+ Year's

This position is on-site.

OC Sports & Entertainment, LLC

jobs.title: Composer / Sound Designer
jobs.description: About Playtech Founded in 1999, the company has a premium listing on the Main Market of the London Stock Exchange and is focused on regulated and regulating markets across its B2B business. By leveraging its proprietary technology, Playtech delivers innovative products and services to ensure a safe, engaging and entertaining gaming experience. As the gaming industry's leading technology company, it combines business intelligence-driven software, services, content, and platform technology to drive excellence and innovation across the sector. Read more about who we are and what we do here: www.playtechpeople.com and www.playtech.com Here at Playtech, we genuinely believe that people are our biggest asset. Diverse thoughts, experiences, and individual characteristics enrich our work environment and lead to better business decisions. Embracing differences and maintaining transparency in our processes is the core of Playtech's overall commitment to responsible business practices. Ready to level up your career? Playtech's Sound team is looking for a talented Composer/Sound Designer to collaborate with our international team and create immersive in-game music, design sound effects, and prepare sound packages for our online slot games. HOW TO APPLY? A portfolio showcasing music and sound design work created for slot games is a mandatory part of the application. Please submit your CV together with multiple relevant work samples and, where possible, video demonstrations of completed projects. Your influential mission. You will... Create in-game music in a variety of genres for online slot games. Design sound effects and musical parts for animations and game events. Prepare game packages in a variety of sound formats. Edit and mix sound for promo videos. Components for success. You... Possess 1+ years of experience in composing and sound design in the slot industry. Ability to provide examples of completed slot game work, ideally including video demonstrations of the final implementation. Have a passion for composing music and creating engaging audio experiences for players. Have access to a home studio with your own music production setup and extensive SFX libraries. Have experience composing original music across multiple genres, including orchestral, traditional, rock, electronic, and dance. Have a strong understanding of adaptive and interactive game audio, including loopable music, gameplay-driven transitions, anticipation builds, and bonus stingers. Are experienced creating high-quality sound effects for games and interactive products. Demonstrate strong audio editing, arranging, mixing, and mastering skills. Possess advanced proficiency with professional DAWs such as Ableton, Nuendo, Pro Tools, or similar. Have strong knowledge of industry-standard plugins, virtual instruments, and modern music production workflows. Are comfortable playing and recording musical instruments as part of the creative process. Understand player behaviour and the role audio plays in engagement and game performance. Thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working closely with designers, artists, developers, product teams, and external partners. Are able to work independently and confidently guide the creative direction of projects through music references and concepts. Communicate proficiently in English. You'll get extra points for... Prior experience in the gaming/slot industry. Thrive in a culture that values... Initiative-taking and confident approach at the workplace. Global scope and inclusive working environment. Constant learning and development opportunities. Active lifestyle and mental well-being. Fun and engaging company events. SOUND TEAM There are several global game production studios within the Playtech family. Each studio is made up of Game Producers, Artists, Animators, Mathematicians, and Developers who collaborate to create high‑quality content for top‑performing games. These games are then distributed to our clients and players around the world. As a Composer/Sound Designer, you will be part of our Ash studio sound creative team and work closely with Game Producers and Studio Artists to bring our content to life through music and sound effects. Playtech is an equal opportunities employer. Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams. We celebrate differences and encourage everyone to join us and be themselves at work.
